observation.what: a health review can enumerate every non-allowlisted ssh accept across its whole window in one pull

origin.rerun: bash scripts/ops/diag_fetch.sh "journalctl?unit=ssh.service&since=<window start>&lines=2000" and compare the last returned timestamp with now: coverage is complete only when it reaches the present

what: [health] The security-breach sweep of the live VM auth log CANNOT cover a review window: the diag journalctl relay caps at 2000 lines and the trainer VM alone logs ~400 accepted ssh sessions per hour, so a 3-15 day window is ~1.5-6 h of coverage. This review sampled 3 slices (2026-10-17 20:57-22:50Z, 10-24 03:00-04:36Z, plus the first 300 lines) = ~3.5 h of ~15 days -> auth-log check is PARTIAL by construction, which the skill would otherwise score as clean. Fix: a server-side filter (exclude the trainer source / only Accepted+Failed from non-allowlisted sources) or a daily detector that records non-allowlisted accepts to comms/.
